answer_1.quote: We evaluate BARThez on five sentiment analysis, paraphrase identification, and natural language inference tasks ... and two generative tasks from a novel French summarization dataset, OrangeSum, that we created for this research.
answer_1.outputs: Generated summaries (abstract and title) for French documents

answer_2.quote: We report ROUGE-1-2-L scores (Lin, 2004) and BERTScore scores ...

answer_4.quote: We conducted a human evaluation study with 11 French native speakers... We asked evaluators to base their judgments on accuracy (does the summary contain accurate facts?), informativeness (is important information captured?) and fluency (is the summary written in well-formed French?).
answer_4.guideline: Best-Worst Scaling: annotators compare pairs of system outputs and choose the better and worse summary according to specified criteria.
